risk_note: RV2 (admin module, export of personal data): the four admin export operations of contract CT-24k / 08 BR-ID-42 go live (x-implementation planned removed; route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated). Create: export guard, source permission (users → user.list), an unmasked task runs a second AdminOperationGuard on pii.reveal_phone (totp tier, token consumed on 2xx, 202 counts) with reason 1–200 and its own export_unmasked audit; task, audit and the generate job in one transaction; no idempotency key. List: own tasks, audit.view_all widens; progress null outside running. Download: creator only, points re-checked, unknown / other / cross-app / lost points all 20001 fields=[id]; done and not past expires_at else 30417 with status; link valid min(5 min, remaining), signed on every call, audited before the response, no-store. Retry: creator only, failed only via transitionExportTask with row_version CAS, checks of creating repeated, back to pending with the generate job and audits. Worker (B1-34e code): the fixed key <app>/<public_id>.csv is deleted only inside a transaction holding the task row FOR UPDATE after the lock-held check; a run that lost its lease writes nothing; upload hard timeout ≤ lease/3; a late upload that lands after another run finished turns that task done→expired and deletes the object. Residual (Codex r3 S1, downgraded to S2 by orchestrator ruling D10-138): with a fixed key and a put that cannot be aborted, a late upload landing after the new run's upload and before its complete can still overwrite it; unreachable today (only the memory and unavailable stores exist) and recorded as a precondition of the real OSS adapter (B1-30: per-run key + conditional or abortable put).
